children: Hang Seng Index Futures open interest in the current-month contract rose by 1,935 contracts to 129,625 yesterday, while total open interest across all maturities increased by 3,200 contracts to 140,509, according to ETNet.

Net open interest in the current-month contract stood at 35,722, down 3,655 from the previous day. Net open interest across all maturities was 40,148, down 3,506. ETNet reported that the figures include current-month open interest in the night session.

title: Hang Seng Index Futures Open Interest Rises To 129,625 Contracts
